tasks.title: Academic Discussion
tasks.class: Business Ethics- Ethical Practices or Profit
tasks.instruction:
Your professor is teaching a class. Write a post responding to the professor's question.
In your response, you should do the following:
• Express and support your personal opinion.
• Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Gupta
professor.text: We've been discussing the importance of ethical behavior in business. Ethical practices, like fair wages or sustainable production policies, can enhance a company's reputation and build trust with customers. Some argue that companies should prioritize ethical practices even if it affects profitability, while others believe that profit should always come first. What is your opinion on this issue?

posts.name: Claire
posts.text: Ethical practices should be prioritized in business. Building trust with customers and maintaining a positive reputation can lead to long-term success. Even if it affects short-term profitability, ethical behavior ensures long-term, sustainable growth.

posts.name: Andrew
posts.text: Profit should come first in business decisions, especially in cases when the business is new and needs to grow. Companies need to be financially healthy to continue operating and providing jobs. Ethical practices are important, but they should not compromise a company's ability to be profitable.
